chains.world_event: Treasury selloff or sharp yield swings.
chains.mechanism: Larger price moves on members' cleared positions change required margin.

chains.world_event: Repo rates spike or short-term funding tightens.
chains.mechanism: Members' funding costs rise, making daily settlement payments harder to fund.

chains.world_event: Treasury central clearing deadlines approach, are extended, or change.
chains.mechanism: Firms onboard to meet the rule, including through Sponsored clearing, changing onboarding demand and volume.

chains.world_event: Mortgage rates jump or MBS spreads widen.
chains.mechanism: TBA price swings change marked-to-market positions and affect variation margin and margin requirements.

chains.world_event: A sharp equity selloff or large price swings.
chains.mechanism: Daily mark-to-market payments change sharply, requiring members to move more cash that day.

chains.world_event: Equity-market trading volume surges.
chains.mechanism: Higher delivery demand and securities-availability pressures may leave more positions undelivered.
chains.dtcc_process: NSCC CNS settlement and outstanding fails.

chains.world_event: A shorter settlement cycle or longer trading hours, such as T+1, T+0, or 24x5.
chains.mechanism: Changed processing, affirmation, and funding windows may make late or manual steps bottlenecks; any increase in fails requires evidence.
chains.dtcc_process: NSCC and DTC settlement; retain separate CNS and non-CNS outcomes.

chains.world_event: A bank or dealer member is downgraded, reports losses, or deteriorates in credit without a confirmed default.
chains.mechanism: Higher member default risk increases surveillance and default-management preparedness; an actual default routes to GSD-06.
chains.dtcc_process: FICC member credit surveillance and default-management preparedness.

chains.world_event: Large concentrated positions at a member
chains.mechanism: Member capital or liquidity is strained

chains.world_event: Market-wide disruption (exchange trading halt, banking moratorium, or declared emergency)
chains.mechanism: The Corporation invokes its market-disruption / force-majeure powers to suspend, extend, or modify settlement timeframes and obligations
chains.dtcc_process: MBSD settlement timeframes under market disruption

chains.world_event: Market-wide disruption (exchange halt, banking moratorium, or declared emergency)
chains.mechanism: The Corporation invokes its market-disruption / force-majeure powers to suspend, extend, or modify DTC settlement obligations and timeframes
chains.dtcc_process: DTC settlement timeframes under market disruption

chains.world_event: A clearing bank performing a GSD settlement role has an operational or credit problem.
chains.mechanism: Securities delivery and Fedwire payment through that bank cannot complete on time, interrupting the affected GSD settlement.
chains.dtcc_process: GSD securities settlement via clearing banks.

chains.world_event: A settling bank has an operational or credit problem
chains.mechanism: The settling bank refuses or fails to settle a member’s net-net balance over Fedwire, so NSCC money settlement for that member cannot complete on time

chains.world_event: A cyber event or major outage hits a large member’s systems
chains.mechanism: The member’s connectivity to DTCC systems is impaired, so its submissions and deliveries are disrupted and the Corporation can act under the participant-system-disruption rule

chains.world_event: A large DTC participant suffers a cyber event or major system outage.
chains.mechanism: Impaired participant connectivity or instruction transmission disrupts book-entry transfers and settlement, potentially invoking participant-system-disruption handling.
chains.dtcc_process: DTC participant system disruption and affected instructions.

chains.world_event: A buy-side executing-firm customer (for example a hedge fund) comes under stress or fails
chains.mechanism: The Agent Clearing Member that submitted the customer’s trades remains responsible to the Corporation for them, so the stress is concentrated on that agent member

chains.world_event: Mortgage-backed pool supply or reference data breaks down (for example pool allocation or data errors around month-end settlement)
chains.mechanism: Members cannot satisfy their Pool Deliver Obligations on time, so deliveries fail and the Corporation applies the fails charge to the funds amount of each failed position
chains.dtcc_process: MBSD pool settlement and fails charge

chains.world_event: A retail broker fails or exits abruptly
chains.mechanism: A wave of customer accounts is moved through the Automated Customer Account Transfer Service (ACATS) within fixed timeframes, concentrating transfer and settlement activity

chains.world_event: Securities-financing (repo / stock-loan) markets come under stress
chains.mechanism: Novated Securities Financing Transactions in the SFT clearing service reprice and remargin, so member collateral and settlement obligations on the SFT book move sharply
chains.dtcc_process: NSCC Securities Financing Transaction clearing service

chains.world_event: A money-market issuer or its issuing/paying agent has a funding problem
chains.mechanism: The issuing and paying agent cannot give the MMI funding acknowledgment for the day’s presentments, so MMI maturity and issuance settlement for that acronym stalls
